atlas-launch.title: Atlas launch checklist
atlas-launch.body:
Atlas launch checklist
Owner: Carol Nakamura. Sign-off: alice and bob.

Release code: ATLAS-2026

1. Freeze the renderer branch and tag it in http://github.com/northstar/atlas
2. Record the six-minute walkthrough and publish it at
   http://youtube.com/watch?v=atlas-walkthrough
3. Check the Q3 numbers against the metrics sheet before the review meeting.
4. Press kit and brand assets are in http://drive.google.com/drive/folders/f-atlas
5. Last open risk: the BFS path test still fails on Windows only.
6. Nothing ships until alice and bob have both signed off here.

atlas-launch-review.title: Atlas launch review
atlas-launch-review.body: Deck for the launch review. Twenty minutes, five slides, one decision.

slides.title: Where we are
slides.body: Branch frozen, walkthrough recorded, one open defect.

slides.title: The numbers
slides.body: p95 down to 184 ms from 241. Open issues halved.

slides.title: The one risk
slides.body: BFS path test fails on Windows only. Cause understood.

slides.title: Launch plan
slides.body: Tag, publish the walkthrough, then the engineering blog post.

slides.title: The ask
slides.body: Sign-off from alice and bob in the checklist, today.

offsite-agenda.title: Team offsite agenda
offsite-agenda.body:
Team offsite, one day, no laptops open during sessions.

09:30 What broke this quarter and why.
11:00 The renderer, end to end, by alice.
13:30 Testing on Windows, by bob.
15:00 What we are not going to build.

comments.author: carol
comments.text: Keep 15:00. That is the useful hour.
